verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's automations/scheduled tasks feature explicitly supports event-driven triggers (Gmail, Slack, GitHub) instead of just fixed schedules, letting users define rules that fire actions on external events, and lets them review active/paused/completed runs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification that these event triggers work reliably in practice, and detail on how flexible/general the rule definitions can be beyond the three named integrations.
